title: Do the lithium-ion cell designs found with a fast model still win under the full porous-electrode model?
lede: re-scoring 49 designs from energy-cell under PyBaMM's full DFN model instead of SPMe: rank correlation 0.86 at cycle 100, the SPMe winner is 3rd of 45 and still +38% over the reference cell (+31% under SPMe), DFN reports about 19 Wh/kg more on average, and SPMe fails to cycle 3 designs DFN handles; against measured discharge curves of two real cells, the models are indistinguishable at low rate, and at 2C on the Ai 2020 cell DFN fits to 18 mV RMSE against SPMe's 53 mV (modelled, stack level)
summary: Takes the first next step of energy-cell: the 49 designs it logged (baseline, each search run's best, 36 spread over the SPMe ranking, 3 SPMe failures) are re-scored with the same parameters, protocol and mass model under the full Doyle-Fuller-Newman model. Over the 45 designs both models cycled, the cycle-100 Wh/kg rank correlation is 0.86 (0.93 at beginning of life); the SPMe winner (143.4 Wh/kg) is 3rd of 45 under DFN (160.9 vs 163.0 for the DFN best) and beats the reference cell by 38% under DFN against 31% under SPMe. DFN gives more energy for nearly every design (mean +18.6 Wh/kg), with gaps up to 127 Wh/kg, and the SPMe plateau is not flat under DFN. SPMe's collapse on two designs at a 5 A charge is an electrolyte salt-diffusion limit: doubling the electrolyte diffusivity removes it (SPMe within 2% of DFN), while swapping SPMe's conductivity treatment only shrinks it. Against published measured discharge curves (Ecker 2015 Kokam cell at 1C and 5C, Ai 2020 Enertech pouch at 0.1C to 2C, each with its published PyBaMM parameter set), SPMe and DFN differ by under 1 mV at low rate, so the data cannot separate them there; at 2C on the Ai cell, where the electrolyte drops to 30% of its initial salt, DFN fits to 18 mV RMSE against SPMe's 53 mV, while at 5C on the Ecker cell the models differ by 6 mV and both miss by about 70 mV (the thermal treatment and the mesh each move that error more than the model choice). Limits: one cell for the design study, one parameter set, 49 designs chosen to spread over the SPMe ranking; both models share the same degradation parameters and the measured-data check covers two other cells, not the OKane2022 designs; stack-level mass only. Every input comes from energy-cell and PyBaMM's OKane2022 set.
